title: KTÜ students' AI early-warning app pings phones about 30 seconds before a Kulu quake is felt at the Turkish parliament, 15 May 2025
summary: KTÜ students' AI quake app alerted phones about 30 s before a Kulu quake (DHA 5.2, USGS 5.0) was felt at Turkey's parliament, 15 May 2025.
account: On 15 May 2025 software-engineering students from Karadeniz Technical University were presenting their Erken Uyarı Merkezi (Early Warning Center) to members of parliament. DHA's report describes it as an AI-based earthquake early-warning system. During the presentation, in the TBMM Public Relations building in Ankara, a quake centered in Kulu, Konya, was felt in the capital. DHA gave the magnitude as 5.2. USGS lists M5.0 at 15:46 local time (12:46:37 UTC), 14 km east-north-east of Kulu at 10 km depth. Student Birkan Yılmaz said notifications had reached their phones 30 seconds before the quake. Students, some MPs and building staff went outside. The read reports mention no damage or injuries.
purpose: A student-built earthquake early-warning system meant to notify phones before shaking arrives. Warning the room before the Kulu quake was felt was that intended function, demonstrated live during the team's own presentation to MPs.
system: Erken Uyarı Merkezi (Early Warning Center), AI-based earthquake early-warning system built by Karadeniz Technical University software-engineering students
developer: Karadeniz Technical University (KTÜ) software-engineering students (DHA); no company or faculty lead named
deployer: Karadeniz Technical University (student team), demonstrating the system at the TBMM Public Relations building
domain: Disaster risk reduction / earthquake early warning
taxonomy_note: An earthquake warning is read as a detection mechanism; no averted injury is documented.

ratings.reason: MPs, students and staff in the TBMM Public Relations building got about 30 seconds' notice, on the developer's own account. They went outside. No damage or injury is reported, so the benefit is the notice itself.

ai_role.statement: The system is called yapay zeka tabanlı (AI-based) in DHA's report, on the students' description. None of the read reports explains how it detects quakes, what data it uses, or whether the alert time was logged. The 30-second lead is the statement of student Birkan Yılmaz, a member of the team that built it. DHA carried it and Haberler, Yeni Akit and Yeni Çağ reproduced it. No MP, AFAD or Kandilli comment on the alert was found. Leaving the building was a human response to the notification and to the shaking.

produced_by: A quake large enough to be felt in Ankara from an epicentre in Kulu, Konya (DHA 5.2; USGS M5.0 at 10 km depth). This left a gap between detection and the arrival of shaking in the capital.
The team's own phones carrying the app, with connectivity inside the TBMM building, during a live demonstration to MPs
An audience already primed by the presentation to treat the notification as a cue to leave

The detection source and false-alarm rate are undocumented in the read reports. Reliability beyond this one event is therefore unknown.
Recipients must act on the notice. Here students, some MPs and staff went outside.

revisions.change: Record drafted from the OECD Monitor entry and the cited sources. All four readable sources carry the same DHA report; ensonhaber.com and gercekgundem.com returned HTTP 403 and were not read. USGS lists the Kulu event as M5.0 mww at 2025–05–15T12:46:37 UTC, 10 km depth, 14 km ENE of Kulu; DHA reports 5.2. The system name Erken Uyarı Merkezi appears in the Yeni Çağ texts. No KTÜ, AFAD or parliamentary statement was found; web search was unavailable in this session. Filed as protective response with prevention unproven as the classifier proposed: the warning is documented only by the developer's statement in a DHA report, and no harm was averted.
Benefit type set to Increased Product Safety under Trustible's full taxonomy of 23 types; it was Improved Accessibility among the six first used.
Added what the benefit is measured against from the cited sources.
Country of the developer and the deployer added from the organization's own site or a registry.
Prose pass: a rating reason, account, purpose, the replication conditions, the system's part rewritten in shorter sentences with abbreviations expanded; facts, figures and quotations unchanged.
Organization name standardized to Karadeniz Technical University.
